ApiError.description: The common error envelope returned by controllers, authentication and servlet filters.

code.description: Machine-readable refusal the client acts on, for example UPLOAD_ROW_REJECTED (a 400 caused by a row's own content), ENROLLMENT_CANCELLED or ENROLLMENT_STUDY_CHANGED.

message.description: For pending enrollment, names blocking participants and explains that the device can finish or the researcher can cancel pending enrollment.

blockingParticipantIds.description: Present when live, unacknowledged enrollment attempts block the edit.

settingsVersion.description: Settings revision the rows were judged at; 0 from an endpoint that does not judge by revision.

StudySettingsPreconditionFailure.description:
Returned with HTTP 412 when an `If-Match` settings precondition no longer matches. Carries
the current state so the client can re-render without issuing another GET and racing again.

EnrollmentResponse.description:
Returned by mobile enrollment endpoints. The request identifies a
pseudonymous app-device instance; the response identifies both the
deduped server device record and the individual enrollment event.

Servers that support per-device API keys populate `apiKey`; legacy
servers may return `null`.

For backward compatibility with the legacy upstream server, clients
also accept a bare UUID string response and treat it as
`{chronicleId: <uuid>, enrollmentId: null, apiKey: null}`.

enrollmentId.description: Server-assigned UUID for this enrollment event.

apiKey.description:
Per-device API key bound to (studyId, participantId, chronicleId).
Sent as `X-Api-Key` for subsequent uploads to this server. Shown ONCE.

hardStopGeneration.description: Current hard-stop generation, the phone's durable baseline before this enrollment starts collecting.

StudyParticipantPolicy.description: Study-specific informed-consent and privacy notice controlled by the responsible institution.

EnrollmentManifest.description: Authoritative disclosure snapshot a participant reviews before enrollment.

withdrawalMode.description: The study policy for keeping or erasing prior data on withdrawal.

DataDeletionOperation.description:
A requested erasure or collected-data purge. QUARANTINED means requested, data
blocked and nothing erased yet. `erasable` is the server's answer to whether an
owner may run it now (Erase now); clients do not restate the rule from `status`.

EnrollmentWithdrawalResponse.description:
Accepted participant self-service withdrawal. `requestId` is the exact
client-supplied UUID bound to the authenticated credential, and exact
retries observe the same response. The first winning withdrawal owns
the durable deletion job only when the study selects ERASE. KEEP_PRIOR_DATA
returns no deletion job and preserves prior data. A later request from another device records
`alreadyWithdrawn: true` and may return no deletion job IDs rather than
claiming the first device's operation.

requestId.description: Client-generated withdrawal request UUID, stable across retries.

deletionJobIds.description: Deletion jobs owned by this exact withdrawal request. Empty when the study keeps prior data, or `alreadyWithdrawn` is true and another request already owns the participant's durable erasure operation.

alreadyWithdrawn.description: True when a prior withdrawal or erasure already applies to the participant.

AndroidSensorSetting.description: Hardware-sensor sampling policy (chronicle-models AndroidSensorSetting). Every field is optional on input; the server applies the listed default.

CollectionModuleId.description: Stable lowercase snake_case identifier for a data collection module. Reserved IDs freeze the namespace for future modules. Unknown IDs are ignored on read, never fatal.

CollectionCadence.description: How often a collection or upload action runs.

CollectionModuleSetting.description: Per-module configuration entry inside an AndroidDataCollectionSetting. Carries no apiKey, signing secret, or participantId — pure configuration.

consentEpoch.description: Server-derived consent reset revision in device settings; ignored on settings writes.

enabled.description: Whether the module is active. Privacy-sensitive modules are never enabled implicitly.

required.description: Whether the module is mandatory for study participation (per-module consent design §3.1). Meaningful only when enabled. Required modules must be accepted to enroll and cannot be self-disabled in the Data Sharing surface; optional modules (the default) are participant-toggleable. Defaults false for legacy settings.

sensorPolicy.description: Per-sensor sampling policy (rate Hz + duty cycle). Only the per-sensor sensor_* modules populate this — each carries its own rate/duty (web-editable, mobile read-only); every non-sensor module leaves it null.

healthConnectRecordTypes.description: Exact Health Connect record families approved for this study; valid only on health_connect.

declinedModules.description: The modules the participant declined in this snapshot (defaults empty).

unavailableModules.description: Enabled sensor modules the device reported as physically unavailable in this snapshot (defaults empty). Non-sensor modules are invalid here.

AndroidDataCollectionSetting.description: Generalized Android data collection setting, bound to the DataCollection study setting type. A polymorphic StudySetting subtype, added additively — it is returned from GET /settings/type/DataCollection and rides the existing @class-discriminated StudySetting mechanism. Missing modules use safe defaults; omitted sensors remain disabled.

settingsVersion.description: Server-controlled revision of the actual settings content. Defaults to 1.

StudySettingsAuditEntry.description: A single immutable entry in a study's settings-change audit trail. Records who changed which setting type, when, and from where, with the full before/after snapshot and a human-readable change summary (module-granular for DataCollection). The backing table is append-only (DELETE/UPDATE revoked from all application roles).

sourceIp.description: Client IP the change originated from, if known.

settingKey.description: The StudySettingType that changed (e.g. DataCollection, AndroidSensor).

beforeValue.description: Full snapshot of the setting before the change; null on first configuration.

BatterySample.description:
One battery-telemetry sample produced by the Android `battery_telemetry`
collection module. DEVICE_STATE_METADATA-class data — carries no participant
content. Units follow Android BatteryManager / ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED.

producerVersion.description: Collector app version recorded with this sample at capture; omitted/null when unknown. Length is measured in Unicode code points; a value must contain a character outside Unicode White_Space. Must not be inferred from current enrollment or upload version.

id.description: Stable per-sample identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at sample time.

levelPercent.description: Battery charge level as a percentage.

temperatureDeciC.description: Battery temperature in tenths of a degree Celsius; may be negative.

IosBatterySample.description:
One battery-telemetry sample produced by the iOS `battery_telemetry`
collection module. DEVICE_STATE_METADATA-class data — carries no participant
content. Deliberately slimmer than the Android `BatterySample`: iOS exposes
only charge level, a coarse charging state (UIDevice.batteryState), and Low
Power Mode — temperature, voltage, health, and plug type do not exist on iOS
and are stored as NULL, never fabricated.

id.description: Stable per-sample identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at sample time.

levelPercent.description: Battery charge level as a percentage.

chargingState.description: Mapped from UIDevice.batteryState — unknown→UNKNOWN, unplugged→DISCHARGING, charging→CHARGING, full→FULL. NOT_CHARGING is never produced on iOS.

lowPowerMode.description: Whether Low Power Mode was active at sample time; omitted when unknown.

AndroidInteractionEvent.description:
One interaction-salience event produced by the Android `interaction_events`
collection module. INTERACTION_METADATA-class data — content-free by
construction: it carries raw accessibility-node screen bounds and display
context, the element role (view class name), and the foreground package,
but never element text or contentDescription. The node bounds are not the
participant's finger/pointer coordinate. Center, normalized, and grid fields
are legacy derivations.

id.description: Stable per-event identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at event time.

gridRows.description: Number of rows in the screen-region grid the event was bucketed under.

gridCols.description: Number of columns in the screen-region grid the event was bucketed under.

elementRole.description: The interacted element's role (view class name); never its text.

foregroundPackage.description: Package name of the foreground app at event time.

positionSource.description: Provenance of the raw position observation; null on legacy clients.

nodeBoundsLeft.description: Raw left edge of the accessibility node in screen pixels; may be negative.

nodeBoundsTop.description: Raw top edge of the accessibility node in screen pixels; may be negative.

nodeBoundsRight.description: Raw right edge of the accessibility node in screen pixels.

nodeBoundsBottom.description: Raw bottom edge of the accessibility node in screen pixels.

displayId.description: Logical display id whose coordinate space contains the node bounds.

rawX.description: Legacy derived horizontal center of the accessibility node. This is not a pointer coordinate; new consumers should derive positions from the raw node bounds.

rawY.description: Legacy derived vertical center of the accessibility node. This is not a pointer coordinate; new consumers should derive positions from the raw node bounds.

screenWidth.description: Width of the node's logical display coordinate space at event time. Populated with element-position context; null in the grid-only mode.

screenHeight.description: Height of the node's logical display coordinate space at event time. Populated with element-position context; null in the grid-only mode.

normalizedX.description: Legacy normalized accessibility-node center. New consumers should derive positions from the raw node bounds and display context.

normalizedY.description: Legacy normalized accessibility-node center. New consumers should derive positions from the raw node bounds and display context.

scrollDeltaX.description: Signed horizontal scroll delta in pixels for a SCROLL event; null otherwise.

scrollDeltaY.description: Signed vertical scroll delta in pixels for a SCROLL event; null otherwise.

eventTimeMillis.description: Monotonic event time in ms since boot (AccessibilityEvent.getEventTime / SystemClock.uptimeMillis domain); authoritative for ordering and kinematics. Null on legacy clients.

episodeId.description: Opaque id grouping a burst of interactions into one episode (reset after an idle gap), for scanpath / per-session reconstruction. Null if not grouped.

dwellMillisSincePrev.description: Milliseconds since the previous interaction in the same episode (inter-event dwell; a hesitation/reading-time proxy). Null for the first event of an episode.

orientation.description: Display rotation at event time as a Surface.ROTATION_* ordinal (0 portrait, 1 landscape, 2 reverse-portrait, 3 reverse-landscape). Populated with element-position context; null otherwise.

screenDensityDpi.description: Display density in DPI at event time (so raw pixels are physically interpretable). Populated with element-position context; null otherwise.

scrollVelocityX.description: Horizontal scroll velocity in pixels/second for a SCROLL event; null otherwise.

scrollVelocityY.description: Vertical scroll velocity in pixels/second for a SCROLL event; null otherwise.

scrollReversed.description: Whether this SCROLL reversed the previous scroll's dominant direction (a re-reading / back-tracking signal). Null for non-scroll events or when there is no prior scroll.

AndroidAudioActivityEvent.description:
One audio-activity event produced by the Android `audio_activity`
collection module. Behavioral-metadata-class data — mic-free by
construction: it carries which app is producing audio, the
playback/route/volume state and ringer/DND posture, but never any audio
content or microphone capture.

id.description: Stable per-event identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at event time.

audioActive.description: Whether audio playback was active at event time.

audioPackage.description: Package name of the app producing audio; null if none/unknown.

contentType.description: Coarse audio content type from the audio attributes; null if unavailable.

playbackState.description: Active media session playback state; null if no session.

outputRoute.description: Active audio output route; null if unavailable.

routeConnected.description: Whether an external output route (e.g. headphones) was connected; null if unavailable.

mediaVolume.description: Current STREAM_MUSIC volume index; null if unavailable.

maxMediaVolume.description: Maximum STREAM_MUSIC volume index (so mediaVolume is interpretable); null if unavailable.

ringerMode.description: Device ringer mode at event time; null if unavailable.

dndActive.description: Whether Do Not Disturb was active at event time; null if unavailable.

callActive.description: Whether a telephony/VoIP call was active at event time; null if unavailable.

AndroidAudioContentEvent.description:
One audio-content event produced by the Android `audio_content`
collection module. Media-content-class data — the opt-in track-metadata
path: it carries the active media session's title / artist / album and
play position for the foreground audio package, never the audio itself.

id.description: Stable per-event identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at event time.

audioPackage.description: Package name of the app whose media session produced this metadata.

title.description: Media session track title; null if unavailable.

artist.description: Media session track artist; null if unavailable.

album.description: Media session track album; null if unavailable.

durationMillis.description: Track duration in milliseconds; null if unavailable.

positionMillis.description: Playback position in milliseconds at event time; null if unavailable.

AndroidNotificationActivityEvent.description:
One notification-activity event produced by the Android
`notification_activity` collection module. Behavioral-metadata-class
data — content-free by construction: it carries per-app notification
posted/removed events with category and importance, but never any
notification text or title.

id.description: Stable per-event identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at event time.

packageName.description: Package name of the app that posted/removed the notification.

category.description: Notification category (e.g. msg, call, alarm); never its text. Null if unavailable.

ongoing.description: Whether the notification was ongoing (non-dismissable); null if unavailable.

importance.description: NotificationManager importance level for the notification's channel; null if unavailable.

AndroidSleepEvent.description:
One sleep sample produced by the Android `sleep` collection module (Play
Services Sleep API). Health-metrics-class, content-free and mic-free: a sleep
label/confidence plus the coarse light/motion levels the on-device classifier
reports. No raw sensor stream leaves the device.

id.description: Stable per-event identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at sample time.

segmentStartMillis.description: SEGMENT start (epoch millis); null for a CLASSIFY.

segmentEndMillis.description: SEGMENT end (epoch millis); null for a CLASSIFY.

confidence.description: Sleep confidence 0-100 from a CLASSIFY; null for a SEGMENT.

light.description: Ambient-light level the classifier reported; when known.

motion.description: Device-motion level the classifier reported; when known.

AndroidActivityRecognitionEvent.description:
One activity-recognition sample produced by the Android `activity_recognition`
collection module (Play Services Activity Recognition / Activity Transition
API). Behavioral-metadata-class (default OFF), content-free: an activity label
plus confidence, no raw sensors or location.

id.description: Stable per-event identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at sample time.

transitionType.description: For a transition sample, whether activityType was entered/exited; null for a periodic result.

AndroidHealthMetricEvent.description:
One health metric read from the system Health Connect store by the Android
`health_connect` collection module. Health-metrics-class, opt-in. Each sample
is a single aggregated/instantaneous record over [startMillis, endMillis].

id.description: Stable per-event identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at sample time.

value.description: The metric value, interpreted per metricType and unit.

unit.description: Unit for value (e.g. count, bpm, m, kcal, %).

endMillis.description: Record window end (epoch millis); equals startMillis for an instantaneous reading.

sourcePackage.description: Package of the app/wearable integration that wrote the record, when known.

AndroidConnectivityStateEvent.description:
One content-free connectivity-state sample produced by the Android
`connectivity_state` collection module. Device-state-metadata-class (default
OFF): the active transport plus metered/validated flags. No SSID, BSSID, IP, or
cell identifiers are captured.

id.description: Stable per-event identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at sample time.

connected.description: Whether a network was connected at sample time.

metered.description: Whether the active network is metered; when known.

validated.description: Whether the active network has validated internet; when known.

AndroidAppNetworkUsageEvent.description:
One per-app network-usage sample produced by the Android `app_network_usage`
collection module (NetworkStatsManager). Behavioral-metadata-class (default
OFF) — volume counts only: the transmitted/received byte counts for one app
over one time bucket, with zero visibility into payloads, destinations,
domains, or URLs.

id.description: Stable per-event identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at sample time.

packageName.description: Package whose usage this is; or a uid:N form when unresolvable.

AndroidUploadDiagnosticEvent.description:
Bounded, redacted occurrence: count equivalent Android failures at one instant
(firstOccurredAt equals lastOccurredAt). The phone never merges different instants,
so the server can filter each occurrence by the participation window. Participant,
device, and destination identity are supplied by the authenticated request and
connection rather than duplicated in this body.

issueCode.description: A code this server does not know, from a newer app, is stored as UNRECOGNIZED_ISSUE.

AndroidDeviceSettingsEvent.description:
One content-free device-settings snapshot produced by the Android
`device_settings` collection module. Device-state-metadata-class (default OFF):
a curated set of display / sound / accessibility / system toggles. Every field
is content-free and identity-free; all are nullable so a partial snapshot still
serializes.

id.description: Stable per-event identifier, used for de-duplication on upload.

timezone.description: Device-default time-zone id at sample time.

darkMode.description: Whether system dark/night mode is active; when known.

accessibilityEnabled.description: Whether any accessibility service is enabled; when known.

dndActive.description: Whether Do-Not-Disturb / a non-ALL interruption filter is active; when known.

batterySaver.description: Whether battery-saver / power-save mode is active; when known.

autoRotate.description: Whether auto-rotate is enabled; when known.

locationServicesEnabled.description: Whether the location-services OS switch is on (NOT a location); when known.

storageFreeBytes.description: Free internal storage in bytes; when known.

storageTotalBytes.description: Total internal storage in bytes; when known.

screenBrightness.description: Screen brightness level (Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS, typically 0–255); when known. Only directly meaningful when screenBrightnessAuto is false.

screenBrightnessAuto.description: Whether adaptive/automatic brightness is on; when known.

mediaVolume.description: Media/music stream volume step (no audio is recorded); when known.

mediaVolumeMax.description: Max media stream volume on this device — makes mediaVolume interpretable.

ringVolume.description: Ringtone stream volume step; when known.

ringVolumeMax.description: Max ringtone stream volume on this device.

notificationVolume.description: Notification stream volume step; when known.

notificationVolumeMax.description: Max notification stream volume on this device.

alarmVolume.description: Alarm stream volume step; when known.

alarmVolumeMax.description: Max alarm stream volume on this device.

ringerMode.description: Ringer mode (normal / vibrate / silent), from AudioManager; when known.

screenWidthPixels.description: Display width in pixels at report time; null if unavailable.

screenHeightPixels.description: Display height in pixels at report time; null if unavailable.

screenDensityDpi.description: Display density in DPI at report time; null if unavailable.

displayRotation.description: Display rotation as a Surface.ROTATION_* ordinal (0..3); null if unavailable.

interactionPointerCaptureCapability.description: Device/API-specific reason exact finger coordinates are unavailable to Chronicle's non-interfering collector; null on legacy clients.

availableSensors.description: Every AndroidSensorType the device has, checked whether or not a sensor module is enabled; a type missing here is one the device lacks.

ScreenTimeUsageRecord.description: One DeviceActivity App & Web Usage total of one app or web domain over one observation window. An `application` record names the app (`appName` or `bundleIdentifier`) and no `webDomain`; a `webDomain` record has a non-null `webDomain` (including an empty string supplied by Apple) and neither app label. Category labels are independent of row kind. The server refuses any other record as a row defect.

usageByPackage.description: Device usage in seconds, keyed by package name.

AppUsageDayState.description: Answer state of one ended survey day.

today.description: The server's current day in the study time zone; not answerable until it ends.

users.description: Stored answer; absent while the block is unanswered.

post.summary: Enroll a participant's device in a study

parameters.name: X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id
parameters.description:
Chronicle app-instance ID generated and encrypted by the mobile app.
This is not an Android hardware identifier. It remains stable while
app data is intact so same-app re-enrollment can be distinguished from
multiple app instances for the same participant.

parameters.name: X-Chronicle-Enrollment-Code
parameters.description:
One-time participant enrollment code delivered in the enrollment-link
URL fragment. Public mobile builds use it to bootstrap enrollment
without embedding a shared server secret. The server consumes it for
this exact study and participant; it is never reusable.

parameters.name: X-Chronicle-Manifest-Digest
parameters.description:
Lowercase SHA-256 digest returned by enrollment-preview. Required when
X-Chronicle-Enrollment-Code is used; enrollment is rejected if the
study policy or collection settings changed after preview.

parameters.name: X-Chronicle-Enrollment-Attempt-Id
parameters.description:
Client-generated canonical UUID for this durable enrollment attempt,
stable across exact retries. When X-Chronicle-Enrollment-Code is used,
all four invitation credential headers (code, manifest digest, attempt
ID, and proposed API key) are required together.

parameters.name: X-Chronicle-Proposed-Api-Key
parameters.description:
Client-generated per-device API key proposed for this durable enrollment
attempt. It is bound to X-Chronicle-Enrollment-Attempt-Id and must remain
stable across exact retries. It is required whenever the one-time
enrollment-code flow is used.

409.description:
The study the participant reviewed changed before the attempt bound (code
ENROLLMENT_STUDY_CHANGED). The invitation stays live; opening it again shows the
current study. Other 409s are a server-side conflict and are retried.

410.description:
A cancel (dashboard or phone) ended this enrollment attempt (code
ENROLLMENT_CANCELLED). The participant is not withdrawn; a new invitation enrolls.

200.description:
Enrollment response for this app-instance enrollment event. On servers
that issue per-device API keys (the BCM server) `apiKey` is populated
and the client uses `X-Api-Key` for uploads; legacy upstream servers
may return `apiKey: null`.

delete.summary: Withdraw the authenticated device's own enrollment
delete.description:
Participant self-service withdrawal. The enrollment to withdraw is
identified entirely by the participant- and device-bound API key —
no study or participant appears in the path. Auth (`X-Api-Key`) and
the Chronicle app-instance id (`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride the
standard v4 mobile headers.

Idempotent: before its first request the client generates and durably
stores a canonical lowercase UUID in
`X-Chronicle-Withdrawal-Request-Id`. The server binds that exact UUID
to the authenticated credential and creates deletion work at most
once. A revoked key remains accepted here (only here) for an exact
bound retry until a newer active key exists for the same device, so a
client that crashed mid-request can safely retry and observe the same
withdrawal result.

Cancelling an enrollment attempt: with the attempt's proposed key and
`X-Chronicle-Withdrawal-Request-Id` set to the attempt id, an attempt
without an ENROLLMENT acknowledgment is cancelled, whether or not its key
installed: the attempt's key and binding are revoked and the receipt names
the attempt. It never withdraws the participant. After the acknowledgment the
cancel is refused with 409; a real enrollment ends only through withdrawal.
An attempt the server holds no binding for answers 410 and is recorded as
cancelled, so its delayed enroll is refused.

parameters.name: X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id
parameters.description: Chronicle app-instance ID generated and encrypted by the mobile app.

parameters.name: X-Chronicle-Withdrawal-Request-Id
parameters.description: Canonical lowercase UUID generated and persisted by the client before the first withdrawal attempt, then reused unchanged for every retry of that withdrawal.

410.description: The key is unknown or the attempt was never bound; the refusal is final.

202.description:
Withdrawal accepted. Participation is marked NOT_ENROLLED and the device
API key is revoked. Data collected before withdrawal stays available by
default. Studies configured for ERASE keep the withdrawn data blocked until a
study owner runs the erasure. For a cancelled enrollment attempt the receipt
names the attempt and nothing is withdrawn.

get.summary: The bound device's participation status poll
get.description: The phone's status poll, read in one snapshot: the participation status, every closed capture window, the latest hard stop (Mark not enrolled or withdrawal) and the database clock. A phone that was enrolled again before it polled learns of the hard stop here and clears what it queued before the stop. An erased key reads ERASED with no windows and no hard stop.

410.description: The pending enrollment was cancelled; request a new invitation.

post.summary: Report a participant's acknowledgment of newly-enabled collection modules
post.description: Records a participant's on-device acknowledgment of one or more newly-enabled collection modules — the device-side close of the consent loop. A module a researcher enables stays in PENDING_ACK (not collecting) until the participant acknowledges it on-device. Auth (`X-Api-Key`) and app-instance id (`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride the standard v4 android headers. The server stamps its own authoritative receipt time; the body's `acknowledgedAt` is advisory only.

post.summary: Upload Android usage and lifecycle event data
post.description: Uploads the authenticated app instance's usage and lifecycle event batch. Every event carries a `clientEventId` assigned once on the phone; the server stores each ID at most once per study participant, so a retried batch never duplicates rows. The app-instance id is carried in `X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`; the participant- and device-bound API key is carried in `X-Api-Key`.

200.description: Accepted and deliberately discarded client event IDs

post.description: Uploads the authenticated app instance's Android sensor sample batch. The app-instance id is carried in `X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`; the participant- and device-bound API key is carried in `X-Api-Key`.

(`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride the standard v4 android headers — matching

content or microphone capture. Auth (`X-Api-Key`) and the Chronicle
app-instance id (`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride the standard v4 android

package, never the audio itself. Auth (`X-Api-Key`) and the Chronicle
app-instance id (`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride the standard v4 android

post.description:

`notification_activity` collection module. Behavioral-metadata-class data —
content-free by construction: it carries per-app notification posted/removed
events with category and importance, but never any notification text or
title. Auth (`X-Api-Key`) and the Chronicle app-instance id
(`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride the standard v4 android headers.

parameters.description: Chronicle app-instance ID generated and encrypted by the mobile app.

post.description:
Uploads a batch of sleep samples collected by the Android `sleep` collection
module (Google Play Services Sleep API). Health-metrics-class data —
content-free and mic-free by construction: a sleep label/confidence plus the
coarse light/motion levels the on-device classifier reports. Auth (`X-Api-Key`)
and the Chronicle app-instance id (`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride the standard

parameters.description: Chronicle app-instance ID generated and encrypted by the mobile app.

Uploads a batch of activity-recognition samples collected by the Android
`activity_recognition` collection module (Play Services Activity Recognition /
Activity Transition API). Behavioral-metadata-class data (default OFF) —
content-free: an activity label plus confidence, no raw sensors or location.
Auth (`X-Api-Key`) and the Chronicle app-instance id (`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`)
ride the standard v4 android headers.

store by the Android `health_connect` collection module. Health-metrics-class
data, opt-in. Each record is an aggregated/instantaneous value (interpreted per
metricType + unit); Chronicle only reads records the participant's own
apps/wearables have written. Auth (`X-Api-Key`) and the Chronicle app-instance
id (`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride the standard v4 android headers.

`connectivity_state` collection module. Device-state-metadata-class data
(default OFF) — the active transport plus metered/validated flags only; no
SSID, BSSID, IP, or cell identifiers (those would be a location proxy). Auth
(`X-Api-Key`) and the Chronicle app-instance id (`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride
the standard v4 android headers.

parameters.description: Chronicle app-instance ID generated and encrypted by the mobile app.

post.description:

`app_network_usage` collection module (NetworkStatsManager).
Behavioral-metadata-class data (default OFF) — volume counts only: the
transmitted/received byte counts for one app over one time bucket, with zero
visibility into payloads, destinations, domains, or URLs. Auth (`X-Api-Key`)
and the Chronicle app-instance id (`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride the standard
v4 android headers.

post.description:

`device_settings` collection module. Device-state-metadata-class data
(default OFF) — a content-free, identity-free snapshot of display / sound /
accessibility / system toggles; nothing reveals what the participant does, only
how the device is configured. Auth (`X-Api-Key`) and the Chronicle app-instance
id (`X-Chronicle-Random-Device-Id`) ride the standard v4 android headers.

unrestricted stack traces. Each occurrence is filtered by the participation window

historical name). Auth (`X-Api-Key`) and the Chronicle app-instance id
